entities.summary: Guy count van den Steen de Jehay was a Belgian sculptor. His work was part of the sculpture event in the art competition at the 1948 Summer Olympics. In 1948, he married Lady Moyra Butler, daughter of British peer George Butler, 5th Marquess of Ormonde, in Chelsea, London.
